map.金属收得率 = 合格坯量 ÷ 入炉金属料 × 100%；冶炼损耗（钢损）= 入炉: Metal yield = qualified billet ÷ metal charge × 100%; smelting loss (steel loss) = metal charge − qualified billet. Validation: a metal charge <=0, or a non-numeric qualified billet or finished product, prompts for input; qualified billet > metal charge prompts "qualified billet exceeds metal charge" and aborts. Criteria: the higher the yield, the lower the metal loss in smelting; this is the post-furnace billet to pre-furnace input yield.
map.成材率 = 成品材量 ÷ 合格坯量 × 100%（分母为 0 时记 0）；轧制损: Product yield = finished product ÷ qualified billet × 100% (0 when the denominator is 0); rolling loss = qualified billet − finished product; overall yield = finished product ÷ metal charge × 100%, total loss = metal charge − finished product, total loss rate = total loss ÷ metal charge × 100%. Validation: finished product > qualified billet prompts "finished product exceeds qualified billet" and aborts. Criteria: the overall yield covers both smelting and rolling and is complementary to the total loss rate (they sum to 100%).
